events.title: Sortilège is in Steam Next Fest, October 19-26
events.summary: Sortilège is a roguelite dice duel. You and your rival throw against each other, and every boon you pass up stays on the table for them to take.The demo has a full solo run through the academy, all the way to the Elder Geometer, plus online duels with a friend or through Quick Match. The elite rivals behind the locked doors are in the full game, along with more worlds and the dice sets you win from bosses.If the demo clicks for you, wishlisting the full game is the best way to help.

events.title: Update 0.8 - The Climb
events.summary: Update 0.8 - The ClimbThe solo mode used to be a sequence of fights that was kind of scripted and got very repetitive over time. We wanted to tweak that a little so it is now a climb with a shape: a branching route up the Sortilege academy floors. Levelling your dice and keeping your HP between rounds! events.title: 0.7.0 - Sharper Duels, Lasting Runs
events.summary: Your Boons Are a Deck NowThe old random grab-bag of roll bonuses is gone. Your deck is built to rules: it opens with 12 commons and 3 rares, and when you run it dry a fresh deck is drawn with 12 commons, 3 rares, and 2 epics. events.title: Swipe Right on Dice
events.summary: New little thing we put up. A site where you swipe through dice one at a time, right on the ones you'd want to roll, left on the ones you wouldn't. Find one you like? Give it a name and drop it in the comments. Best ones might end up in the game! These aren't the dice from the game though. They're 1,500 we strategically generated, and we're watching what people pick to work out what actually makes a die fun to look at and roll. events.summary: 0.6.0 is live in the demo now. Jump in and try it!Electric TotalsYour combat totals now render as glowing 3D plasma digits that grow with the value and fly off your dice when you attack. It looks as good as it sounds. First Light charmsFour new good-luck charms join the table: the Candle, Dawn Lantern, Paper Sun, and Dawn Rooster, each with its own animation and presence.
